target: Stock net t+1 adjusted open to t+60 adjusted close minus gross 0050 same endpoints; interior missing quotes do not remove endpoints.
train: Expanding from 2023; label ends by previous Dec31 and first scored signal; known training endpoints only.
selection: Identical finite asof price/flow/45-day-delayed revenue/previous-day-credit pool. No future outcome filtering before selection; unknown selected endpoints retained.
score_year: Year of next-market-day entry. January uses previous-year final close and prior-year purged model.

uncertainty.insufficient: No interval if paired days <= block; never silently shorten block.

monthly.signal: Previous calendar month final market close; entry on next market day. October2026 included, future outcomes unknown.
monthly.label_evaluation: 60-day fixed endpoints overlap; never compound monthly 60-day means.
monthly.portfolio: Monthly review: retain selected holdings, exit fallen names, buy new names from available cash only. Forecast horizon 60; actual holdings follow monthly ranking. Do not reinvest another complete principal every month.
monthly.fill_basis: Explicit hypothetical daily-open quote scenario. No claim of intraday odd-lot fills, actual shares or corporate-action cash ledger.
monthly.missing: Missing reference/open prevents a hypothetical order; missing sale cancels day order and retains holding; missing held valuation is unknown, no forward fill.
monthly.execution: Fixed integer sizing at signal close+1%; whole/odd fee tickets split at1000. Hypothetical open*(1+slippage) must meet limit and cash reserve; no replacements. Adjusted units are synthetic reinvested-return units, not actual shares.
monthly.cash: No leverage or repeated principal. Sale proceeds withheld for a conservative two-market-day settlement proxy; charge minimum fees and sell tax.
